pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop_words":[],"stop_action":"no danger words of its own: the generic screen (danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency, crisis words) is always on","rated_boots":"safety-rated boots (steel toe, electrical hazard): re-soled only with the maker's parts, and the customer is told plainly in writing that the rating can't be promised after any repair; the customer says yes first","medical_shoes":"orthopedic or medical shoes: only the outer repair, never the insole, lift or brace; the reason stays on the secure page","during_work":"a finding that stops the work, like a sole cracked through or an upper torn through: the work stops, a written note and photo go to the customer, and nothing is charged for what wasn't done","house_calls":"a cobbler who feels unsafe at a home leaves, and the owner is told","can_continue":"yes, after the generic steps"}

pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"the check-in code at the counter; a walk-in drop-off is checked in at the counter at once; at a home visit, the code at the door","intake":"a ticket per pair: both shoes photographed, wear and damage noted, the repair asked for, and the date it's needed by; the customer keeps the claim ticket","estimate":"written, item by item, before any work; the customer says yes to all, to some items, or not today; good for 7 days","added_work":"a new problem found while the shoes are in is texted with its price first; nothing extra without a yes; no answer in 2 days: left as it is","ready":"READY texts the pick-up hours, anything due and the held-until date","pick_up":"with the claim ticket or the code; a try-on at the counter; handed over once anything due is paid","done_proof":"the code at pick-up checks the visit in; at a home visit, DONE after the try-on at the return","claims":"a damaged or lost pair is reported within 7 days; the owner decides with the shop's claims policy, never more than the pair's value","unclaimed":"pairs not picked up: reminders at 30 and 60 days after READY, then a final written notice with the date before anything is donated at 90 days, as the state's unclaimed-property rules allow; the owner decides","house_call":"the cobbler looks at the shoes at the home, prices each item, and takes the pair to the shop; they come back on a booked return, with a try-on"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"nothing taken at the shop; a stitched resole takes a $40 deposit that orders the soles; a home visit saves a card for the $15 pickup fee","deposit":"the $40 resole deposit comes off the price; the rest is paid at pick-up; deposit cap: from the state form","after":"the rest at the counter at pick-up; for a home visit, the bill Rosie texts after the shoes come back","fees":"no late-cancel or no-show fee at the shop; at a home visit, the $15 pickup fee for a late cancel or a no-show, only if Sam confirms; it is credited to the work when the work is done","materials":"special soles, dye or hardware bought for a job are added at cost, with a yes first","tips":"no tip line","tax":"where the state taxes the work (the owner's setting)","rosfield_2":"Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies"}

pluginText.pf.rules: {"written_price":"switch: a written price before work, above an amount: from the state form; the shop writes every item anyway","fees_in_first_price":"switch: every required fee, like the pickup fee, inside the first price: from the state form","unclaimed_items":"switch: how long finished pairs are held, the written notice, and the waiting time before they're donated or sold: from the state form; the owner decides, and Rosie sends only the notices the owner OKs","right_to_cancel_at_home":"switch: a right to cancel work sold at the customer's home: from the state form","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"applies":["A no-show or a late cancel: no fee at the shop; at a home visit, up to the $15 pickup fee, only if Sam confirms","More than 15 minutes late: the pair is taken when the customer arrives, or the visit moves","A need-by date, like a wedding: only turnarounds that make it are offered","Yes to some items only","More work found while the shoes are in, with no answer","Safety-rated boots: told plainly the rating can't be promised","The pair isn't picked up: reminders at 30 and 60 days, a final notice, donation at 90","A pair damaged at the shop","A fix asked within 30 days"],"handling":"each the generic way, with the plug-in's words; the owner confirms every fee"}
